headword: {耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}

definitions.explanation: The structural strength of a building or infrastructure against earthquakes, typically measured and graded according to national building standards.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧だ。
examples.english: This building's seismic strength is sufficient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm worried about the seismic strength of the old apartment building.

examples.japanese: 2005⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}した→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧{耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦{偽装|ぎそう}→偽装：09151_gisou⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見直|みなお}し→見直し：09340_minaoshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んだ→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Following the seismic strength falsification scandal that came to light in 2005, building standards were reviewed and tightened.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{耐震|たいしん}→耐震：06222_taishin⟧ (earthquake resistance) and ⟦{強度|きょうど}→強度：27803_kyoudo⟧ (strength; intensity). This term gained widespread public awareness after the 2005 {耐震強度偽装問題|たいしんきょうどぎそうもんだい} (Aneha scandal), in which a structural engineer was found to have falsified earthquake resistance data for numerous buildings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to lack seismic strength
- {耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧: to check seismic strength
- {耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦{偽装|ぎそう}→偽装：09151_gisou⟧: falsification of seismic strength data
- {耐震強度|たいしんきょうど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: seismic strength standards

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{耐震設計|たいしんせっけい}→耐震設計：24940_taishinsekkei⟧: earthquake-resistant design (the design approach)
- {耐震性|たいしんせい}: earthquake resistance (the general property)
- {耐震等級|たいしんとうきゅう}: seismic resistance grade (the rating scale used in Japan, from 1 to 3)
